free_tier.stated: A free API key after a reviewed application: 200 calls per minute (200m) at review Levels 1 to 4, up to 100 results per category per call, and a bulk download of search results to CSV (at most 1,000,000 records) in the Trove account.
free_tier.notes: Most applications are answered within a week; The quota can be raised on request, subject to approval.

per_object_cap.stated: 100 results per category per call (n, default 20)
per_object_cap.notes: Paging uses a cursor (s and nextStart); bulkHarvest=true sorts by identifier so a harvest sees each record once.

retention.stated: bulk download files are deleted automatically seven days after they are created
retention.notes: A caller may hold retrieved metadata for at most 30 days, and only for offline use or where real-time calls would hurt performance; otherwise each display makes a live call.

egress.terms: not applicable: XML or JSON answers; bulk download files are CSV

interface_detail: REST over HTTPS at api.trove.nla.gov.au/v3 (result search, work, newspaper, gazette, magazine titles, list, people) with an OpenAPI file; the key goes in the key parameter or a header; XML by default, JSON with encoding=json
chaining: Metadata for books, images, maps, music, journals and digitised newspaper and gazette articles from Australian libraries; article full text is included with include=articletext for approved uses.

limits.value: 200 API calls per minute (200m) as the standard quota
100 results per category per call; bulk download results limited to 1,000,000 records and 10 downloads at a time
a key is issued after a staff review of an application form; harvesting full text or AI use needs an approved exemption

binding_note: No call works without a key, and the key comes from a reviewed application; 200 calls a minute is met only after that.

identity_cost.detail: A Trove account is needed first (its sign-up fields are unverified: the sign-up page renders by script); then an application form asking for the account username and contact details, the call rate needed, why and how the API will be used, and an agreement to the API terms. No card is mentioned.

reliability_note: A keyless call answered HTTP 401 No API key found in request; the Trove website pages, not the API host, sit behind an Anubis proof-of-work challenge that a plain page fetch stores as a challenge page; keys can be withdrawn at the Library's discretion.
confidence_note: Key process, review levels, quota, caps, bulk download and caching limit are read from first-party pages; a keyless call answered HTTP 401, and the key application is behind a sign-up, so whether an individual key is granted is unverified: behind a sign-up.

notes: Storage: retrieved metadata may be cached for up to 30 days for offline use or performance; otherwise each display makes a live call; bulk download CSV files last 7 days. Bulk path: Download results in a Trove account (CSV of metadata and an abstract, up to 1,000,000 records, one category at a time, 10 downloads at a time) or bulkHarvest=true through the API. This is the read API; the deposit question has its own record in storage.
